rationale: Identity verification was done correctly (matched full name and ZIP to a single user). However, several policy violations occurred: (1) The agent proceeded with an exchange write without obtaining explicit user confirmation after stating the exact change; it said “I’ll start the exchange now” and executed. (2) It fabricated details: claimed the order had both a canister and a robotic vacuum without tool evidence, and selected a canister bagless variant with “pet hair removal” not shown in product variants. (3) It used item IDs for the exchange that never appeared in tool outputs. (4) It did not verify the order’s eligibility/status for exchange. (5) It gave inconsistent and incorrect guidance about refunding the price difference to a gift card (first said yes, then said it’s not possible), without consulting tools. (6) It asserted the exchange was submitted and a PayPal refund would occur without tool-confirmed results or amounts. These issues fail the pass bar requiring correct, confirmed actions and no unsupported claims.
